scope: User-requested magents research experiments using configured APIs
rules: Do not repeatedly ask for fee approval for an experiment bounded at 20 CNY or less.
Ask before launching or extending an experiment whose total budget exceeds 20 CNY.
Do not split one experiment into smaller runs to bypass confirmation.
Record API usage and estimated cost; stop before exceeding the experiment budget.
This records user authorization, not an automatically enforced billing limit. Environment permission approvals remain separate.
